name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or enhancement for Thalos Prime Library
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you are proposing.

## Motivation / Problem Statement

Describe the problem this feature would solve or the use case it enables.

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen, including any API or interface changes.

## Deterministic Guarantees

Describe how the proposed feature maintains determinism (identical inputs → identical outputs).
If the feature introduces non-deterministic operations, explain how they will be seeded and logged.

## Lifecycle Integration

Which lifecycle phase(s) does this feature affect?

- [ ] `initialize()`
- [ ] `validate()`
- [ ] `operate()`
- [ ] `reconcile()`
- [ ] `checkpoint()`
- [ ] `terminate()`

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you have considered, and why you chose the proposed
approach.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.
